title: Adobe Firefly expands AI video editing: more tools across Adobe apps
summary: Adobe expands Firefly AI video editing capabilities across creative applications
detailed: Adobe has expanded Firefly, its generative AI suite, and the update pushes a wider AI-driven video workflow across the company’s creative tools, the company says.
Adobe also says Firefly is trained on licensed material, including Adobe Stock and public-domain sources.
Adobe says Firefly had more than 6 million monthly active users by mid-2026, and some forecasts put the automated video-editing market above $9 billion by 2030.
Adobe says Firefly is available in the browser, on Android and iOS , inside Adobe’s apps, and through its standalone web-based video editor.
sentences: Adobe has expanded Firefly, its generative AI suite, and the update pushes a wider AI-driven video workflow across the company’s creative tools, the company says.

The pitch is straightforward: start with either a text prompt or existing footage, then generate assets, tweak lighting and sound, add captions, make quick edits for social, and use Quick Cut to turn a theme, a prompt, or a batch of raw clips into a rough first cut more quickly.
Adobe also says Firefly is trained on licensed material, including Adobe Stock and public-domain sources.
It now gives users access to more than 800 million stock assets, music included, to make licensing easier.
And it no longer runs only on Adobe’s own tech.
The company has folded in models from Gemini , OpenAI, and ElevenLabs, while also adding prompt-based edits and Generative Extend inside Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.
If you already spend most of your time inside Adobe’s tools, this feels a lot less like a gimmick than it did a year ago.

It looks more like a practical way to move through repetitive production work faster without giving up control of the edit, even if the usual questions still hang over it: how good the output really is, whether heavy automation chips away at craft over time , and how easily the tools can be misused.
